name: io.github.futureweb/intervals-mcp-server
title: Futureweb Intervals MCP
description: Self-hosted Intervals.icu MCP server: training analytics, Garmin data, wellness, workout planning

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PERMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Enabled tool classes: read (default, read-only), read,write, or all (adds destructive and admin tools)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: full (every tool of the enabled classes) or core (curated coaching set)

environmentVariables.name: ATHLETE_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for 'today' and default date ranges, e.g. Europe/Vienna; default: the Intervals.icu athlete profile
